identity.title: Bind governance decisions to actual execution outcomes

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: After 8090 establishes the pre-execution gate, make the evidence chain explicit and queryable: request -> governance decision -> execution or non-execution -> execution outcome. Reuse existing IDs/timeline/evidence normalization. Do not add a tracing subsystem.
human_pressure.why_now: A runtime governance kernel is only useful if audit can distinguish policy denial, pending authority, successful execution and allowed-but-failed execution without inference from prose.
do_not_misread: Do not invent another event store or persistence model.
red_lines: No second timeline/event store, OpenTelemetry platform work, tracing backend, workflow engine or new database.
Do not collapse policy outcome and execution outcome into one status.

machine_core.goal: Make every governed execution/non-execution outcome traceable to the governance decision that authorized, denied or deferred it using existing evidence primitives.
invariants: An executed call references the decision that authorized it.
Blocked and pending calls explicitly prove that no execution occurred.
Allowed execution failure remains distinct from policy denial.
Replay/export preserve the correlation without invoking tools or recomputing policy.

observable_effect.assertion: A stored run can deterministically distinguish request, decision, execution/non-execution and execution result using stable correlation evidence.

failure_semantics: ALLOW plus tool failure is execution_failure, not policy block.
BLOCK is non-execution by governance decision, not tool failure.
Pending authority/review is non-execution pending governance, not success.
Missing correlation never defaults to success.

steps.title: Reuse existing correlation identifiers
details: Inventory current run/request/decision/event identifiers introduced or exercised by 8090.
Choose the smallest existing identifier chain that can bind decision to execution outcome.

steps.title: Record execution/non-execution lineage
details: For allow, record the actual returned/failed execution outcome linked to its decision.
For block/pending, record explicit non-execution linked to the governing decision without fabricating a tool result.

steps.title: Prove replay/export fidelity
details: Demonstrate the same lineage is visible through existing read-only replay/audit/evidence views.
Do not add a new read model when an existing one can expose the correlation.

acceptance: Policy denial, pending governance and execution failure remain distinct.

must_check: 8090 is completed before this pack executes.
Correlation uses existing evidence primitives where possible.
Policy and execution statuses remain semantically separate.
reject_if: Decision and execution outcome are collapsed into one ambiguous status.
A second event store/tracing framework is introduced.
Blocked or pending calls appear as execution failures.

missing_targets: tests/test_execution_evidence_binding.py may be created by this pack
